plan: A fighter who hooks onto walls to swoop in on her target and lock it in a duel.
aSurveiller: Her R (The Hextech Ultimatum). She locks you in a zone with her: your allies can help you, but you can't escape.
contrer: Stay away from walls: her E hooks onto them to leap onto you.
Don't stand at the edge of her W: the outer edge hurts most.
During her R you can't leave the zone: keep your defensive spells and call your allies.
forces: Engages from far thanks to walls.
faiblesses: Weak at the very start of the game.

sorts.Q: Two empowered attacks; the second deals true damage.
sorts.W: Sweep; the outer edge slows and hurts more.
sorts.E: Hooks onto a wall then leaps.
sorts.R: Locks her target in a zone.

momentFort: Strong in the mid game, dangerous from level 6.
